correctness.rationale: Polar constraints |y_i|≤1 and |y_i|+|y_j|≤1 on signed graph edges are reconstructed exactly. Optimizing squared norm in the nonnegative orthant at maximal clique coordinate M yields max(q,(p+q)/4), with only signed 0/1 independent coordinates or signed half-coordinates as optimizers (q≥2). All such extrema are polar vertices/facet normals and count 2^q or 2^(p+q); signed span determines center locus (p if p<3q, 0 otherwise). Strict slack on all other finite polar vertices ensures small p-dimensional translations. Symmetry proves maximal centered inball global, outer radius sqrt2 and signed root contact count. Independently tested exact polar-feasible grids in 7 small (p,q) profiles; these are corroboration, not proof for arbitrary p,q.
